## let id name done ratio
BOUND_id=42
BOUND_name=close the $issue "now"
BOUND_done=false
BOUND_ratio=1.5
after unlet:
BOUND_id=unset
BOUND_name=unset
BOUND_done=unset
BOUND_ratio=unset
## let nothing missing
BOUND_nothing=
BOUND_missing=
after unlet:
BOUND_nothing=unset
BOUND_missing=unset
## let state tags empty
BOUND_state=0."type":str="started"
0."since":map
1."day":int=3
BOUND_tags=0.0:str="x"
0.1:str="y"
BOUND_empty=0.:list
after unlet:
BOUND_state=unset
BOUND_tags=unset
BOUND_empty=unset
## let state.type state.since.day state.missing state.type.deeper
BOUND_state_type=started
BOUND_state_since_day=3
BOUND_state_missing=
BOUND_state_type_deeper=
after unlet:
BOUND_state_type=unset
BOUND_state_since_day=unset
BOUND_state_missing=unset
BOUND_state_type_deeper=unset
